title: VLTest: Finding Joint Image-Text Failures in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly embedded in software systems. Testing them raises two problems. Mutating either input can change the expected answer, so an output change is not by itself a failure. Some failures appear only when both inputs are mutated; attributing them to the combination requires testing each mutation alone. We present VLTest, a black-box VLM testing approach. It generates image variants by editing VQGAN latent codes and text variants with a rewrite-expand-prune pipeline, filters variants likely to change the expected answer, and tests each variant alone before testing combinations, so every joint failure has four matched cells. A VLM judge confirms a failure only after checking that the input keeps the expected answer. translated_title: VLTest：发现视觉-语言模型中的图像-文本联合失效
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被嵌入到软件系统中，对它们进行测试会带来两个问题：其一，对任一输入进行变异都可能改变预期答案，因此输出变化本身并不必然意味着失效；其二，有些失效只在两个输入同时被变异时才会出现，而要将这类失效归因于输入组合，就必须先单独测试每一个变异。我们提出了VLTest，一种黑盒VLM测试方法。它通过编辑VQGAN潜码生成图像变体，通过“重写-扩展-剪枝”流水线生成文本变体，并过滤掉可能改变预期答案的变体；在测试组合之前先单独测试每个变体，从而使每一个联合失效都拥有四个匹配的测试单元格。一个VLM裁判只有在核实输入仍保持预期答案后才会确认失效。在涵盖八个VLM（包括两个商业API模型）的三项任务上，该判定器确认了81.7%的候选失效，与人工标注相比精确率达到88.8%至94.6%，并通过四单元格确认……
tldr: VLTest是一种黑盒视觉-语言模型测试方法，通过分别和联合变异图像与文本输入，并采用四单元格对比和VLM裁判验证，精准发现仅由图像-文本组合触发的模型失效。
en_tdlr: VLTest is a black-box testing approach for vision-language models that mutates image and text inputs both individually and jointly, using a four-cell comparison and a VLM judge to precisely identify failures triggered only by image-text combinations.
